name: Planner
description: Breaks a request into pieces, each with the sub-goal it must meet and the worker category that fits it; on a replan it plans again only what failed. The arms are a rule router that reads the words of the request, a single-piece baseline and a model planner.
purpose: Turn a request into pieces that can be done and checked, each with the worker category that fits it, and replan from what failed.
approach: Break the request into pieces, each with the sub-goal it must meet and one worker category, and plan again only the pieces that failed when the goal was unmet; the arms differ in how they read the request (by its words, or by a model), not in what they return.
out_of_scope: Doing a piece (Delegation hands it on), and setting the target of the request (Metric Translation).
milestones: 1. Each piece of a request has a sub-goal that can be done and checked (authoritative metric metric-request-planner).
measures_of_success: Each piece of a request has a sub-goal that can be done and checked.
inputs: A request, its context, its target and the guidance, when there is some.
outputs: The pieces of a request, each with the sub-goal it must meet.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
